summary: Govern browser continuity with shared immutable archives.
details: The server and two-client lifecycle use one resource-governed process tree. Phase profiles share verified archive hardlinks, move private settings, omit MIR during removal and restore its original archive on re-addition. Existing gameplay oracles remain required.

Candidate admission validates source-patch identity and canonical README bytes through the existing materializer transformation. Controlled actor and archive checks preserve historical evidence without claiming new native multiplayer, physical input or release acceptance.
